aspect: Return becomes impossible in a sense that has nothing to do with travel
description: The address exists, the building exists, and nothing that made it home does. Physical return delivers the loss again rather than resolving it.
energy_note: You can go back. There is nothing there to go back to.

description: Destroyed or inaccessible cemeteries remove the one physical site where grief is conventionally performed, and there is no substitute for it.
Land registries, birth records and parish books destroyed or altered means descendants cannot document ancestry, claim property, or prove they are from where they are from.
